name: silos
description: Run your Claude Code and OpenCode agents like a team: what a terminal hides — what each agent loaded, remembers, costs and left running — on one screen, on your machine.
author: Cheapestinference Lab, Co.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && npm test -w plugin-opencode && npm test -w silos-id
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w plugin-opencode && npm run typecheck -w silos-id
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e -w web && npm run e2e -w web
